name: Irelia
notes: The opening cast is Vanguard's Edge (R) at t=0; its initial barrage and its perimeter/zone damage are both applied to the dummy at once, since a stationary target is treated as passing through the forming perimeter at the moment it is hit.

Bladesurge (Q) is cast on cooldown; consuming it while the dummy carries the Unsteady mark (applied by E or R) drops its cooldown to a flat 0.2 seconds instead of the full cooldown, and its dash-and-forced-attack is approximated, like Leap Strike's, by the standard 0.25 s cast lockout.

Defiant Dance (W) is always held to its full 0.75 s charge for maximum swipe damage before recasting, since the stationary dummy never punishes the channel; the recast carries its own 0.25 s cast time before the damage lands, and the cooldown starts then.

Flawless Duet (E) is recast at the wiki's stated minimum delay of 0.15 s (over the bin's differing 0.25 s CDBetweenCast field) and its blades are read as converging over the wiki's stated 0.25 s (over the bin's differing 0.35 s RevTime), to fit as many casts as possible.

Ionian Fervor stacks (up to 4, each granting bonus attack speed) are gained only from ability hits on the dummy, and their 6 s duration is refreshed by every ability hit and every basic attack; at 4 stacks basic attacks also deal the bonus magic on-hit damage.
Bladesurge's heal is not modeled since healing does not affect the fight.
Mana costs are not modeled: the rotation's mana costs are not expected to bind within a 15 s fight at level 16.
Basic attacks fill every gap between ability casts, both for their own damage and to refresh Ionian Fervor's duration.

assumed.why: the wiki leaves it open whether a stationary target 'passes through' Vanguard's Edge's perimeter; the most damaging and commonly cited reading applies the zone hit alongside the initial barrage
picked the wiki's stated 0.15s recast delay over the bin's differing 0.25s CDBetweenCast field
picked the wiki's stated 0.25s convergence travel time over the bin's differing 0.35s RevTime field
